cohort: 78,931 women giving birth at 12 public hospitals in Nepal
finding: While labor augmented with oxytocin was associated with improved monitoring and reduced risk of cesarean section, it may increase the risk of adverse perinatal outcomes like bag-and-mask ventilation, low Apgar scores, and neonatal death.
mod_finding: Women with oxytocin-augmented labor had a decreased risk of emergency cesarean section compared to those without oxytocin augmentation.
